core: Both communities run a mid-task ablation on an agent's retained scratchpad/notes: at a checkpoint before a later stage of the task, they deliberately alter the accumulated notes (either wiping them or replacing them with a degraded rewrite) and then measure how much the downstream stage's performance or recovery depends on the fidelity/presence of those retained notes, as opposed to the model's base capability.
quote_1: We wiped the scratchpad right after the injected 503 to see if it could recover the plan from context alone, and it couldn't
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ was applied immediately before the synthesis stage using a smaller-model rewrite of the retained notes.
